'''Mad'ahn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A rare [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] Twi'lek, she had a small shop in the [[Senate Commercial District]] where she sold weapons and armor.
